title: Digital Marketing Executive – Website, SEO & Content
description:
About the job:

Key responsibilities:

A. Website and Content Management
1. Update and maintain content across multiple company websites regularly.
2. Add and update product details, offers, promotions, deals, banners, landing pages, blogs, and other website content.
3. Ensure website content is accurate, up-to-date, well-formatted, and aligned with marketing objectives.
4. Coordinate regularly with direct clients, agencies, and affiliate networks to collect information about ongoing promotions, sales, offers, products, and campaigns.
5. Monitor promotional campaigns and ensure that offers, links, banners, and website information are updated on time.
6. Create new landing pages, articles, blogs, and other website content based on marketing requirements.
7. Optimise website content for search engines while maintaining a good user experience.
8. Identify opportunities to improve website content, navigation, engagement, and conversions.

B. SEO and Website Growth
1. Implement SEO strategies to improve organic traffic, keyword rankings, and overall website visibility.
2. Conduct keyword research for SEO and PPC campaigns using relevant keyword research tools.
3. Perform on-page SEO, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal linking, image optimisation, and content optimisation.
4. Identify content opportunities based on keyword research, competitor analysis, search trends, and website performance.
5. Create and manage backlinks through relevant and reputable platforms and communities such as Reddit, Quora, social media platforms, business directories, and other appropriate sources.
6. Monitor search engine rankings and identify opportunities for improvement.
7. Regularly audit websites for SEO issues and recommend corrective actions.
8. Stay updated with major SEO trends, search engine updates, and best practices and implement relevant improvements.
9. Support SEO initiatives for multiple websites, domains, and projects.

C. Website and WordPress Management
1. Manage day-to-day website updates and maintenance using WordPress and CRM.
2. Upload, edit, format, and publish website content.
3. Create and manage pages, blog posts, categories, menus, images, banners, and other website elements.
4. Ensure websites are properly formatted across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
5. Identify and resolve basic website formatting, functionality, and content-related issues within WordPress.
6. Regularly audit websites to improve user experience, site structure, page speed, and mobile responsiveness.
7. Install, configure, and manage relevant WordPress plugins, including SEO, caching, security, forms, analytics, and other marketing-related plugins.
8. Coordinate with developers or technical teams when an issue requires advanced technical support.
9. Maintain website hygiene by regularly reviewing outdated content, broken links, unnecessary plugins, and other issues affecting website performance.

D. Digital Marketing and Campaign Management
1. Support the implementation of digital marketing strategies across websites and other online channels.
2. Monitor campaign performance and identify areas requiring optimisation.
3. Coordinate with clients, agencies, affiliate networks, and internal teams to ensure campaigns and promotions are implemented correctly.
4. Monitor traffic, engagement, conversions, and other key performance indicators.
5. Assist in creating landing pages and marketing content for different campaigns and target audiences.
6. Ensure tracking links, CTAs, promotional content, and campaign information are correctly implemented.

E. Social Media Management
1. Develop monthly/weekly social media content plans for company and relevant brand channels.
2. Create social media posts, captions, creatives, and content ideas.
3. Manage and update social media channels regularly.
4. Repurpose website blogs, company updates, offers, industry insights, and marketing content for social media.
5. Monitor engagement and identify content opportunities to improve social media presence.
6. Stay updated with social media trends and recommend relevant content formats and ideas.
7. Coordinate with designers or use basic design tools where required to create social media creatives.

F. Analytics and Reporting
1. Track and analyse website traffic, user behaviour, SEO performance, and campaign metrics.
2. Use Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Search Console to monitor website performance.
3. Use SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms for keyword research, backlink analysis, competitor research, and SEO monitoring.
4. Prepare regular reports covering website traffic, keyword rankings, organic growth, campaign performance, and other relevant metrics.
5. Identify trends and opportunities from performance data and recommend improvements.

Testing and MLOps

title: Computer Vision Specialist
description:

We're building a phone-based athlete measurement platform: a player records a sprint, jump, or agility drill on an ordinary phone, and our vision pipeline returns a number a coach can trust. The hard part isn't detecting a person in a frame - it's producing a measurement that holds up when the phone is handheld, the light is bad, the ground is uneven, and the same athlete is retested a week later.

title: Full Stack Developer

About the job:

We are hiring a Product Engineer to maintain, test and build new features across our region-specific donation-pickup websites and the backend systems that drive order fulfilment. This is a full-spectrum role. You will not be siloed into one layer - you will work across backend, frontend, internal tooling and automation, take ideas from concept to production, and own them end-to-end. As you ramp up, you will grow into independently owning major modules of the product. Because the team is small, you will see your work reach real people - real donations, picked up at real doorsteps - the same week you ship it. It also means working at startup pace. We set deadlines and we hit them. You will juggle multiple priorities, make calls without perfect information, and ship on time without dropping quality. We hire builders who span the whole stack, move fast, and own their work end-to-end. We care about what you can build, not where you went to school. If you have shipped real things - freelance projects, your own plugins, live client sites - that counts, whether or not it came with a job title.

2. Build new features end-to-end, from backend logic through to frontend implementation.
3. Write and maintain internal tooling and automations that make our operations smoother and our team faster.

5. Debug, troubleshoot and root-cause issues across the stack, often working independently.
6. Take responsibility for the reliability and uptime of what you build - these are live sites processing real donations, so things break and need fixing.
7. Gradually take full ownership of major modules of the product as you ramp up.

Why join us:

1. Real ownership, early - you will own major modules of the product, not a narrow slice of someone else's machine.
2. Work that matters - every feature you ship helps a reusable item reach someone who needs it.
3. Full-stack range across backend, frontend, tooling and automation.
4. And a lean team that is serious about doing things well.

Working remotely:

1. This is a fully remote role.

title: Associate Software Tester
description:
About the job:

QBits Tech builds software that helps businesses manage search, merchandising, content, and e-commerce operations. Our product, QBits, is a multi-tenant SaaS platform with catalog management, configurable business rules, search experiences, and preview and publishing workflows.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who can understand complex product workflows, identify gaps, and build reliable manual and automated testing practices.

About the role

You will own testing across QBits's web application and APIs, working closely with product and engineering from requirements through release. You should be comfortable exploring features independently, questioning unclear requirements, and turning business scenarios into repeatable tests.

Key responsibilities

1. Review requirements, designs, and acceptance criteria to identify missing scenarios and potential risks before development.

2. Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test data, and regression suites.

3. Perform functional, exploratory, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing.

4. Validate responsive layouts, cross-browser behavior, accessibility basics, and consistent user experiences.

5. Test REST APIs, including authentication, authorization, validation, pagination, filtering, error handling, and data consistency.

6. Build and maintain automated UI and API tests using Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript, or a comparable framework.

7. Test multi-tenant behavior, role-based permissions, and tenant data isolation.

8. Validate catalog, category, attribute, search, filtering, sorting, merchandising rules, and preview-to-publish workflows.

9. Test edge cases such as large datasets, bulk operations, concurrent updates, failed requests, retries, and partial failures.

10. Report defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, and supporting screenshots, logs, or network traces.

11. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and investigate failures and flaky tests.

12. Communicate release readiness, remaining defects, test coverage, and quality risks clearly.

Required skills

1. 2-5 years of hands-on experience testing web applications and APIs.

2. Strong understanding of test design, defect management, and the software development lifecycle.

3. Practical experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or a similar automation framework.

4. Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript for writing and debugging automated tests.

5. Experience with Postman or equivalent API testing tools.

6. Ability to use browser developer tools to investigate network requests, console errors, and UI issues.

7. Familiarity with SQL or MongoDB queries for backend data validation.

8. Working knowledge of Git and CI/CD workflows.

9. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and clear written communication.

10. Ability to work independently and prioritize testing based on business impact and risk.
